author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
Welcome, Foolish…Gourds? | Mickey’s Not-So-Scary Halloween Party | Magic Kingdom
Our pumpkin pals, Gourdo, Lil Jack and Slushie are back for another season of fun at Mickey’s Not-So-Scary Halloween Party at Magic Kingdom Park®. Happening now through October 31, 2026, on select nights. Learn More – http://di.sn/6006B1lOMj

This year, Lil Jack gets the idea that more friends = more candy, which kicks off the pumpkin pals’ night as they meet some Characters from around the Park. They’ll warm up their vocals with the Cadaver Dans over by Frontierland. They’ll yap about the Boo To You Parade with Madame Carlotta and Butler Broome outside the Haunted Mansion. Lil Jack will also discover sweet treasure troves of candy bucket after candy bucket from the Trick-or-Treating trails before it’s time to go see the fireworks.

Did they make friends? Yes. Did they find more candy because of said friends? Double yes.

What's happening at Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party 2026:
🎃 Mickey's Boo-To-You Halloween Parade
🎃 Hocus Pocus Villain Spelltacular
🎃 Disney's Not-So-Spooky Spectacular fireworks
🎃 The Cadaver Dans in Frontierland
🎃 Trick-or-treat trails across Magic Kingdom
🎃 Exclusive Character greetings & Halloween-themed food and drinks
🎃 And even more spook-tacular fun!

Grab your best costume, practice your biggest pumpkin grin, and join us for a not-so-scary night at Magic Kingdom Park at Walt Disney World!

Tell us your favorite moment in the comments below!
